text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...The lights were still on at this hour,
so I wondered, and sure enough...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You look pale.
Are you getting proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riko Kashimoto, an executive official of the URA
currently working at Tracen Academy,
was standing right beside me before I knew it.
choice_data_list: I've just been so busy lately...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If you collapse, Trainer, your student will worry.
Be conscious of your position.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she, too,
had just finished up her work for the day.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose I'm not really in any position
to talk today either, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we headed home while exchanging thoughts
and information about our training.
